title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_die_shannara_chroniken_die_grossen_kriege_3_die_by_terry_brooks_o60yc (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_die_shannara_chroniken_die_grossen_kriege_3_die_by_terry_brooks_o60yc' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or executed. Installation of this package may lead to full system compromise, including unauthorized access to stored secrets and keys.
